name: Immich
author: immich-app

control._comment: Stop order matters: the API server first, then the ML container (which only exists when the `ml` compose profile is active, hence optional), then the datastores it was talking to. Start is the reverse.

description: Self-hosted Google Photos: timeline, albums, sharing, and background camera backup from the phone to this box. Four containers on a bridge network, of which only the server is published, on 127.0.0.1:2283.
